label: the identity-continuity + latency comparison DESIGN — SAM3 vs the repo's CURRENT path on the SAME authorized fixtures (the acceptance's 'compare identity continuity and latency'; designed, NOT executed — the typed refusal governs)
designStatus: typed not-measured: no SAM3 number exists (auth-gated + resource-infeasible on this host); the current-path side is the repo's own recorded W201+W204 pipeline

entryPoints: video PCS: Sam3VideoModel + add_text_prompt (text concept 'football player') -> per-frame object_ids + boxes + masks + scores
tracker video PVS: Sam3TrackerVideoModel + box/point prompts from the W-lane detections -> per-frame per-object masks
theTwoSides.identitySurface: session-scoped int object_ids propagated by the model's memory state (the card's zero-shot tracking claim: 'detect, segment, and track objects using text or visual prompts')
theTwoSides.latencySurface: per-frame model forward (propagate step) + post_process per frame; GPU-first (bfloat16 per the card's recipes); CPU fallback documented but latency-infeasible

entryPoints: W201 contrast-context detector (packages/perception-detection — the license-clean production path: pure code, zero external components, deterministic, CPU)
W204 greedy-IoU association tracker (packages/perception-tracking/src/tracker.ts — IoU-threshold association, maxGap tolerance, close-all at scene cuts; t<seq> EntityIds)
theTwoSides.identitySurface: session-scoped EntityId track ids in the t<seq> scheme; conservative by design (a scene cut or gap>maxGap CLOSES a track — re-detection opens a NEW id; the fragmentation this produces is exactly what the W204 identity-continuity benchmark measures)
theTwoSides.latencySurface: detection + association per frame (both pure deterministic CPU stages; association is geometric-only, no model forward)

theAuthorizedFixtures.corpus: scripts/evidence/spr-corpus-bytes/ (the frozen SPR substrate: 8 clips, sha-256-pinned, acquired under the recorded R606 registration declaration — analysis / transformation / derivative generation / storage; repo private)
selectedForTheComparison: sprclip-b8-inplay-original (b8p3.mp4, sha 969af7c6fdb17209…) — real in-play R606 source: the multi-player identity stress case (occlusions, crossings)
sprclip-b1-wide-broadcast (clip-b1-wide-broadcast.mp4, sha 3a3c249ef351aaff…) — the wide-angle tracking case (small players, dense crowd overlap)
sprclip-b2-closeup (clip-b2-closeup.mp4, sha e65ae48740472f57…) — the close-up segmentation quality case (large masks, few identities)
sprclip-b3-fast-action (clip-b3-fast-action.mp4, sha f88e3bd5f88f047b…) — the fast-motion identity-continuity case (the swap/fragmentation stress)
theAuthorizedFixtures.fixtureHonestNote: the b8p3/b1 WAV extractions of HF009 prove the extraction recipe; the video frames come per the repo's decoding convention (decode-order + presentation timestamps) so BOTH sides consume the SAME frame sequence

identityContinuityProtocol.metrics: the W204 semantics VERBATIM (packages/perception-tracking/src/benchmark.ts): identitySwitches (consecutive-pair trackId changes summed over GT objects), continuityScore (identityPreservingPairs/totalPairs), fragmentationMeanTracksPerObject; PLUS per-cut continuity (the scene-cut boundary: W204 close-all vs SAM3 memory state — measured per cut window)
identityContinuityProtocol.correspondenceRule: per frame, GT entries matched against predictions with W201's matchDetections (greedy one-to-one IoU matching, label-gated, IoU >= threshold inclusive) — the SAME rule for both sides, so the comparison is identity-level, not detection-level
identityContinuityProtocol.groundTruthHonesty: TYPED GAP: no per-player GT identity annotation exists in the repo (the hf009 search precedent held for speaker ids; the same holds for player ids). The design has TWO honest options: (a) operator-provisioned GT (a human annotates identity walks on the 4 clips — the protocol above consumes them directly), or (b) the CROSS-MODE continuity comparison (label-free): both sides' trackId walks are scored against each OTHER via mask-IoU correspondence on the same frames — labeled a RELATIVE continuity score, never an absolute one. The metric implementations (identity_continuity in benchmark_sam3.py) are delivered + self-checked either way.
identityContinuityProtocol.theSAM3WalkExtraction: per-frame object_ids -> the sam3-<id> EntityId bridge (delivered + self-checked) -> the same walk arrays the metrics consume
identityContinuityProtocol.theCurrentPathWalkExtraction: W204 TrackedBox.trackId per frame (the t<seq> ids) -> the same walk arrays

latencyProtocol.metrics: per-frame wall-clock (ms) per stage: (a) prompt setup (once), (b) per-frame propagate/association, (c) post-process; PLUS end-to-end per-clip wall-clock, FPS, and the realtimeFactor vs the source 25fps; CPU wall-clock labeled as such, GPU honestly N/A on this host
latencyProtocol.theCascadeCost: the repo's current chain is detection-then-association (two cheap CPU stages); SAM3 replaces BOTH with one model forward per frame (plus its memory state) — the cascade cost = SAM3 per-frame time MINUS (W201+W204) per-frame time, measured on the SAME frames of the SAME clips; the self-check's formula (case 6) validates the ratio arithmetic
latencyProtocol.warmupPolicy: 3 warmup frames excluded (the model's first-frame prompt encoding amortizes), then every frame timed; medians + p95 reported per clip
latencyProtocol.streamingCaveat: the card's own warning — streaming inference 'disables hotstart heuristics that remove unmatched and duplicate objects' — so BOTH modes (pre-loaded + streaming) are in the design; the streaming numbers are labeled with the card's false-positive caveat

theComparisonVerdictShape: when executed on an authorized + adequate host, the record gains: identityContinuity.{sam3,current}.{identitySwitches,continuityScore,fragmentation} per clip + latency.{sam3,current}.{perFrameMsP50,P95,fps,realtimeFactor} + cascadeDeltaMs — ALL typed not-measured today; the record-benchmark.ts validator refuses any that appears without a measured run behind it
fixturesConsumptionDesign: frames decoded ONCE per clip (deterministic decode-order), supplied to BOTH sides; the W-lane supplies SAM3's prompts in the PVS mode: W201 DetectedBox (normalized boxes) denormalized to xyxy pixel boxes as input_boxes + positive labels — the 'what prompts would the repo's chain supply' answer (the PCS text mode additionally probes 'football player' as the concept)
